label: Слушать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for слушать (to listen).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Слушаю' is the я-form of слушать with the regular -аю ending of -ать verbs. 'Музыку' is the accusative object of listening.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Слушаешь' shows the -аешь ending on the stem слуша-. 'Учителя' is the accusative object and 'внимательно' an adverb of manner.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Слушает' is the она-form ending in -ает. 'Радио' is the indeclinable neuter object and 'на кухне' the prepositional of place.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Слушаем' is the мы-form ending in -аем. 'Новости' is the plural accusative object and 'каждое утро' frames the routine.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Слушают' closes the present set with the -ают ending. 'Интересную сказку' is the accusative object.

missions.phrase: Вчера я слушал концерт по радио.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Слушал' is the masculine singular past of imperfective слушать, stressing the ongoing process of listening. The perfective послушать would mark a finished spell.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Слушала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Долго' emphasises the extended duration that the imperfective conveys.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Слушали' is the plural past ending in -и. 'Песни' is the plural accusative object and the phrase 'с удовольствием' adds manner.

missions.phrase: Сегодня вечером мы будем слушать лекцию.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 'Будем слушать' joins 'будем' with the infinitive, since слушать is imperfective and forms its future analytically. 'Лекцию' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Слушай' is the informal command formed from the present stem слуша-. 'Меня' is the accusative object; 'пожалуйста' softens the direct request.
